description: This Java interface 'EnforcementFilter' defines a generic contract for enforcement filtering in the Eclipse Ditto model connectivity module. It specifies a method 'match' that compares input data against configured filters, typically used in message processing chains for different connection types like MQTT or AMQP.

classes.name: EnforcementFilter
classes.description: A generic interface for enforcement filters used to match input data against preconfigured filters, ensuring compliance or validation within message processing workflows.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Performs the match operation between the provided filter input and the preconfigured filters, using DittoHeaders for context. Throws an exception if the match fails.
